vb_textbox.text: Remember the first 4 colours you chose.  If that colour has a low payout chose the opposite colour next time.  Stick with the higher payout colours until the payout drops, then switch to the other colour - for example pink = high payout  purple = low payout to begin with then switches.Be consistent with your choices to gain the maximum payout - thr colour combinations stay the same throughout the game - for example pink is always with purple
